headline: Quantum Scaling, Sensing Bounds, and Field Dynamics
summary: Today's highlights span quantum advantage in classical signal sensing, optimal scrambling depth in unitary designs, and foundational mechanics in thermalization and relativistic quantum fields. Together, they push the limits of both practical quantum sensors and fundamental quantum information dynamics.

themes.title: Quantum Information & Scrambling
themes.body: Theoretical bounds demonstrate logarithmic circuit depth for strong unitary designs alongside a universal aperiodicity criterion guaranteeing finite-time macroscopic thermalization.

themes.title: Quantum Sensing & Optics Hardware
themes.body: New experimental and theoretical architectures demonstrate a 10^7-fold measurement advantage in signal learning and robust field-widened interferometers for turbulent channels.

themes.title: Field Coherence & Entanglement Dynamics
themes.body: Investigations into gravitational cat states and field-coupled detector qubits reveal how coherence partitioning and spectral localization govern quantum correlation harvesting.

connections.body: Both studies analyze how discrete two-level systems interact with surrounding continuum or bosonic environments to extract and preserve non-classical correlations.
